# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Do not commit or push changes without the user's explicit permission; user prefers edits made locally until they ask to commit/push.
- Do not prompt the user to commit or push changes or ask about committing/pushing until the user explicitly requests it; prefer making edits locally and only offer to commit/push when the user asks.
- When the user requests a commit and push, wait for the user to run 'git add' and stage files themselves before performing the commit; do not auto-stage files.
- Do not run builds here; user will test build on Linux. Do not attempt or ask to build in this environment.
